ShortDescription.Value: Election results for every district: exact numbers and maps for winner, margin, turnout and swing. Lightweight, no dependencies.

Publish.LongDescription:
Once your city has a City Hall, it holds elections on a schedule you choose, and every district reports its own result. Turnout and vote choice come from the citizens who actually live there: their age, education, wealth and job.
- A results map colored by winner, faded by how close the race was, plus turnout, swing, party strength and approval views - A card for every district with votes, shares, turnout, margin and swing since the last election - Every past election kept, so you can flick back through your city's political history - Monthly polls between elections, based on the game's own happiness
No other mods required, and nothing changes traffic or time.
